BiblicalUsage: lâtsats means to deride — rare in the text, and exact where it appears. In Hosea 7:5, "he stretched out his hand with scorners.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe derision is the sin of people who have stopped fearing God — princes drunk with wine, stretching out their hands with scorners.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
